title.en: Modifying the Rates of Import Duty on Certain Imported Articles as Provided Under Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred Thirty-Seven, Otherwise Known as the Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines, as Amended.
title.orig: Modifying the Rates of Import Duty on Certain Imported Articles as Provided Under Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred Thirty-Seven, Otherwise Known as the Tariff and Customs Code of the Philippines, as Amended.

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00279_1970_html.txt

text.en:
The articles specifically listed in “Annex A” of this Order as classified under Section 104 of
Republic Act Numbered Nineteen Hundred Thirty-Seven shall pay the rates of import duty indicated opposite

After the expiration of thirty (30) days from the issuance of this Order, all the aforestated articles
entered into or withdrawn from warehouses in the Philippines, for consumption, shall be subject to the rates of
import duty herein prescribed.

Any unwarranted increase in the prices of local products benefited by these tariff changes may
be sufficient ground for the revocation of such tariff changes.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) ALEJANDRO MELCHOR
Executive Secretary
